name: en-agent
description: Agent-shaped text: tool-call arguments and tool definitions. The label is a key rather than a word in a sentence, and there is no prose around a value to give a rule a second chance. Tool names, call ids, JSON schemas and enums are a negative set: replacing one breaks the call rather than the sentence.

samples.note: A tool call's arguments. Every value here is anchored by its key and by nothing else -- there is no prose around it to give a rule a second chance.

The tool definition around the call. The name, the schema and the enum are structure: replacing one breaks the call rather than the sentence. The example in the description is a real address in a real deployment.
